fees.name: Visit visa for tourism/religious purposes (embassy-issued)
fees.validity: Valid 3 months from issue; stay up to 1 month
fees.notes: Fee published by Iraq Ministry of Foreign Affairs for tourist/religious visit visas (groups and individuals).

fees.name: Normal (regular) visa
fees.validity: Valid 3 months; stay up to 3 months (residency registration within 10 days)
fees.notes: MOFA 'regular visa' used for non-tourist purposes including business-type visits; companions exempt.

fees.name: Multiple-entry visa
fees.notes: Fee published by Iraq MOFA for multi-entry visas.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.validity: Valid 3 months; stay up to 7 days
fees.notes: Transit visa type listed on official MOFA page but no fee published; amount unverified.

fees.name: Federal Iraq e-visa (evisa.iq)
fees.validity: 90-day validity, stay up to 30 days (as commonly reported)
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (approx. 50+ countries; mandatory pre-arrival channel since VOA suspension of 1 Mar 2025)
fees.notes: Official portal evisa.iq does not publish the fee on public pages (fee shown only inside the application flow). Third-party sources consistently report ~USD 155-160 total including mandatory health insurance (~206,000 IQD); amount left null as it could not be verified on an official page.

fees.name: Kurdistan Region e-visa (visit.gov.krd)
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (approx. 51 countries) entering via Kurdistan Region (Erbil/Sulaymaniyah); valid for KRI only, not federal Iraq
fees.notes: USD 75 fee is the fee charged on the official KRG portal visit.gov.krd. Portal blocked automated fetch (Cloudflare); figure corroborated across multiple recent sources citing the portal - treat with medium confidence.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (federal Iraq) - suspended
fees.applies: suspended for previously eligible nationalities since 1 March 2025
fees.notes: Iraqi Ministry of Interior suspended VOA issuance from 1 March 2025; travellers must use the e-visa (evisa.iq). Limited VOA reportedly remains at Kurdistan Region airports for eligible nationals; no official fee published.

vfs.note: No evidence of VFS Global, TLScontact or BLS outsourcing for Iraq visas; applications go via the official e-visa portals (evisa.iq, visit.gov.krd) or Iraqi embassies directly.
